title: Knowledge service (OKS)
description: Turns the knowledge service and data file declared by the session's workspace into three native tools (info / check_intent / query): a business question is validated into structured intents, then answered with real rows over a read-only connection. No model is baked in — a workspace opts in with an oks.json, and the agent explores the domain through oks_info, starting from the opaque key "index". The plugin writes nothing into the workspace.
